title: Photoroom proved a one-click wonder for making product shots unmissable
excerpt: With an emphasis on the pro-side of photo editing now, Photoroom is designed for anyone running an online business looking to make product images more enticing.
content_html:
Photoroom mostly does what it says: transform photos of your products into something that looks professional and enticing. The tools are easy to use, and in the main they work really well. If you have an online retail business, this platform gives your products that professional look you were after.

Pros

  • +

    Most AI tools work amazingly well

  • +

    Easy to use

  • +

    Works on many browsers

  • +

    Supports HEIC image format

Cons

  • -

    AI Credits can run out fast

  • -

    Sometimes need to repeat your request for it to work

  • -

    Video Generator needs some work

Why you can trust TechRadar We spend hours testing every product or service we review, so you can be sure you're buying the best. Find out more about how we test.

I've been intrigued by AI photo editors for a while now. Some work well, some not so well. Photoroom falls into the former camp. By and large, I found the AI tools to be very impressive and intuitive to use. There are some caveats to that which I'll get into, but overall, Photoroom delivered what it promises.

But what does it promise, exactly? Now, compared to a lot of AI photo editors, things here are a little different. This isn't a platform for touching up your holiday snaps or brightening up social media posts.

The emphasis here is on business use. Effectively, if you run an online store or similar, then you use Photoroom to transform staid, dull product shots into more enticing and engaging imagery that pops off the page.

Latest Videos FromTechRadar

Keen to see how it's developed since we last reviewed it three years ago - AI has come a long way since then - I tried out the platform to see what I could create.

Photoroom: Pricing & plans

  • Online service via browser, iOS and Android app
  • Aimed at businesses large and small
  • Reasonably priced subscriptions and free trial

You can check out Photoroom by clicking here.

The platform is available online through a dedicated app for your iPhone or Android phone, or if you’re working on a computer, via your favourite web browser. Unlike many I've tested, you're not restricted to either Chrome or Edge here.

As with any online service, you need to subscribe to it to use it with a monthly cost billed annually. Photoroom comes in three tiers.

‘Pro', recommended for ‘solopreneurs’, will cost you $13 per month, billed annually. This level grants you 4,250 AI credits monthly, allows you to perform 1,000 exports, and comes with Photoroom’s standard set of tools.

The middle tier is ‘Max’ and is designed for small businesses. For $35 a month (again, billed annually - all tiers are), your credits are upped to 12,000, your exports to 3,000, and the advanced ‘Video Generator’ tool is now available.

Finally, there’s 'Ultra', for “growing brands”. You’re given 20,000 AI credits,10,000 exports, and can create videos and images in 4K, all for $100 a month.

If you’re looking for a more bespoke option, there’s a tailor-made Enterprise tier, with a tailor-made cost to match.

I recommend checking prices as Photoroom often offer discounts on those standard prices. Plus, you can try any of these tiers free for seven days, although don’t forget to cancel your trial before that should you decide not to carry on with the service and you’re needlessly charged a hefty sum for your forgetfulness.

Photoroom was generous enough to grant me access to their Ultra tier, so let’s see what it’s capable of, and what you can do with all those AI credits.

  • Pricing & plans: 4 / 5

Photoroom: Interface

  • Simple, well designed, and clear interface
  • Easy ways to import images and work on them
  • For an online service, I was impressed

The interface is simple and well organised. Once you’ve logged in to your account, you’ll find a sidebar to the left which contains various tools you need.

Thiss includes all the AI tools in your arsenal, templates, a direct link to your Shopify account if you have one, a batch tool so you can work on up to 250 images at once, a Brand Kit where you keep all your assets, and a Design section where your products’ photos are stored.

All the AI tools, which are essentially all your editing tools, are easy to use: you select one, upload a new photo or select one already in your account, apply the effect and you’re done.

There is one thing that I found surprising: Photoroom supports HEIC, the High Efficiency Image Container. It’s a highly compressed image format that’s been around since 2015 and has been increasingly prevalent since Apple made it the default image format for their iPhones in 2017.

The reason I make a point of mentioning this is because far too many services still do not support it, forcing any image or photo saved as an HEIC to be converted into either a JPEG or PNG prior to import. There is no such issue here, saving you time and frustration.

  • Interface: 4.5 / 5

Photoroom: Tools

  • On the whole, the AI tools do an absolutely excellent job
  • Impressive ways to transform passable shots into something potential customers will love
  • But... not all tools are created equal

Such a service succeeds on the strength of its tools, and Photoroom iss betting the farm on AI for this. But AI is a very generic term these days. Is it really artificial intelligence to remove an image’s background?

I’d put it more in the “complex algorithm does a very good job with what it’s given” category. Same with removing objects or people from a photograph and replacing it with an artificially generated background that blends with the existing one.

Such tools already existed before “AI” became an all-encompassing marketing brand. Or, taking inspiration from Monty Python's The Life of Brian, “it’s not AI, it’s a very clever tool”.

But whether it’s AI or not is less important than how these tools fare: I found the achieved results to be excellent. More often than not in apps like Photoshop or Pixelmator Pro, I end up having to touch up the output of similar tools, but here, it was essentially a one-click wonder.

Tools that really impressed me were definitely more AI based. Say you want to sell a shirt, which you’ve photographed on a surface, with as few wrinkles as you can manage… except you know how it is: such layouts are never really good enough.

Well fret no more: Photoroom has a tool that digitally irons your shirt for you, transforming your amateurish-looking photo into a meticulously smooth out product. Couple that with the background remover tool, and you’re well on your way to have a professional looking photograph.

But why stop there? Photoroom has a bunch of AI-generated models who can wear your outfit for you. There’s even what they call a ‘ghost mannequin’ to puff up your shirt so customers can see what it would look like on someone, without being distracted by an actual (or virtual) person wearing it.

I found all this pretty incredible, and that’s just scratching the surface. It’s not all sunshine and rainbows though: for instance, Photoroom has a Video Generator.

Select a photo, browse through all available templates, maybe even type in a prompt if you need, and the AI will get to work… this is where I encountered the familiar “AI tries way too hard yet fails miserably” syndrome.

Some templates removed my test products from the usual confines of physical reality, sometimes in a most disturbing way. Or they just didn’t work at all as expected. I trust the team working hard on this aspect of the service (what I was able to use bore no relation to their intro video about it, so things are moving fast in this arena), but for now, maybe stick with still images, where the results are truly impressive.

Photoroom: AI credits

  • Set number of monthly credits, so use them wisely
  • Many common AI tools don't cost any credits at all
  • However, sometimes, the requested action won’t work, so try, try again

As you’d expect, most AI tools will cost you credits. A video generation goes for 500 (money not well spent for now), Exporting an image at 2K or 4K will cost you 135 and 240 credits respectively, adding an AI background to an image is worth 5 credits, and so forth.

Thankfully though, some tools you’ll use most often, like removing the background of a shot, retouching a photo or performing some image enhancements won’t cost you a thing (beyond your subscription).

You’ll just have to balance what you are given each month with what you hope to achieve in that time period, with the relief that when an action doesn’t work, you won’t have lost any credits - yes, sometimes an error occurs.

However, I found that if I request the same action again - and again - it finally does what I asked it to. Teething problems, I’m sure, and at least it does work impressively well eventually.

Should I buy Photoroom?

Image 1 of 3

Buy it if...

You’re looking to sell a ton of product and want the images advertising your wares to look their best, using a service that is well designed, and is easy to use (when it works)

Don't buy it if...

You don’t want to encourage the proliferation of AI, know your way around Photoshop anyway, and can’t justify yet another subscription, no matter how great some effects are.

How I tested Photoroom

I tested this service on my trusty Apple MacBook Pro. Generally I do my best to check how software works on a variety of devices, both Macs and PCs and portable devices, when needed.

But as this was an online service, whose tools are dependent on servers the main bottleneck would be my fibre connection. I experienced no issues on that score.

Everything was extremely responsive. The free tools were nearly instantaneous, and depending on the complexity of what I was asking the AI to do, it took gradually longer.

Video creation took the longest amount of time, clocking in at around 4 minutes for me. Still, that didn't feel like a long time, when I got it working.

For more creative tools, we tested the best photo editors.

Steve has been writing about technology since 2003. Starting with Digital Creative Arts, he's since added his tech expertise at titles such as iCreate, MacFormat, MacWorld, MacLife, and TechRadar. His focus is on the creative arts, like website builders, image manipulation, and filmmaking software, but he hasn’t shied away from more business-oriented software either. He uses many of the apps he writes about in his personal and professional life. Steve loves how computers have enabled everyone to delve into creative possibilities, and is always delighted to share his knowledge, expertise, and experience with readers.

sentences.zh: 你是专业人士吗？

sentences.en: Subscribe to our newsletter
sentences.zh: 订阅我们的时事通讯

blocks.html_en: Sign up to the TechRadar Pro newsletter to get all the top news, opinion, features and guidance your business needs to succeed!

sentences.en: Sign up to the TechRadar Pro newsletter to get all the top news, opinion, features and guidance your business needs to succeed!
sentences.zh: 订阅 TechRadar Pro 时事通讯，获取您的企业成功所需的所有热门新闻、观点、功能和指导！

blocks.html_en: ‘Pro', recommended for ‘solopreneurs’, will cost you $13 per month, billed annually. This level grants you 4,250 AI credits monthly, allows you to perform 1,000 exports, and comes with Photoroom’s standard set of tools.

sentences.en: ‘Pro', recommended for ‘solopreneurs’, will cost you $13 per month, billed annually.
sentences.zh: 推荐给“个体创业者”的“Pro”，每月费用为 13 美元，按年计费。

sentences.en: This level grants you 4,250 AI credits monthly, allows you to perform 1,000 exports, and comes with Photoroom’s standard set of tools.
sentences.zh: 此级别每月为您授予 4,250 个 AI 积分，允许您执行 1,000 次导出，并附带 Photoroom 的标准工具集。

blocks.html_en: The middle tier is ‘Max’ and is designed for small businesses. For $35 a month (again, billed annually - all tiers are), your credits are upped to 12,000, your exports to 3,000, and the advanced ‘Video Generator’ tool is now available.

sentences.en: The middle tier is ‘Max’ and is designed for small businesses.
sentences.zh: 中间层是“Max”，专为小型企业设计。

sentences.en: For $35 a month (again, billed annually - all tiers are), your credits are upped to 12,000, your exports to 3,000, and the advanced ‘Video Generator’ tool is now available.
sentences.zh: 每月只需​​ 35 美元（同样，按年计费 - 所有级别均如此），您的积分将高达 12,000，您的导出量将高达 3,000，并且现在可以使用先进的“视频生成器”工具。

blocks.html_en: Finally, there’s 'Ultra', for “growing brands”. You’re given 20,000 AI credits,10,000 exports, and can create videos and images in 4K, all for $100 a month.

sentences.en: Finally, there’s 'Ultra', for “growing brands”.
sentences.zh: 最后，还有“Ultra”，代表“成长中的品牌”。

sentences.en: You’re given 20,000 AI credits,10,000 exports, and can create videos and images in 4K, all for $100 a month.
sentences.zh: 您将获得 20,000 个 AI 积分、10,000 个导出，并且可以创建 4K 视频和图像，每月只需 100 美元。

blocks.html_en: If you’re looking for a more bespoke option, there’s a tailor-made Enterprise tier, with a tailor-made cost to match.

sentences.en: If you’re looking for a more bespoke option, there’s a tailor-made Enterprise tier, with a tailor-made cost to match.
sentences.zh: 如果您正在寻找更加定制的选项，可以选择定制的企业级，并提供与之相匹配的定制成本。

blocks.html_en: I recommend checking prices as Photoroom often offer discounts on those standard prices. Plus, you can try any of these tiers free for seven days, although don’t forget to cancel your trial before that should you decide not to carry on with the service and you’re needlessly charged a hefty sum for your forgetfulness.

sentences.en: I recommend checking prices as Photoroom often offer discounts on those standard prices.
sentences.zh: 我建议您检查价格，因为 Photoroom 经常在这些标准价格的基础上提供折扣。

sentences.en: Plus, you can try any of these tiers free for seven days, although don’t forget to cancel your trial before that should you decide not to carry on with the service and you’re needlessly charged a hefty sum for your forgetfulness.
sentences.zh: 另外，您可以免费试用这些级别中的任何一个 7 天，不过，如果您决定不继续使用该服务，请不要忘记在此之前取消试用，并且您会因忘记而不必要地支付巨额费用。

blocks.html_en: Photoroom was generous enough to grant me access to their Ultra tier, so let’s see what it’s capable of, and what you can do with all those AI credits.

sentences.en: Photoroom was generous enough to grant me access to their Ultra tier, so let’s see what it’s capable of, and what you can do with all those AI credits.
sentences.zh: Photoroom 足够慷慨，允许我​​访问他们的 Ultra 级别，所以让我们看看它的能力，以及你可以用所有这些 AI 积分做什么。

blocks.html_en: • Pricing & plans: 4 / 5

sentences.en: Pricing & plans: 4 / 5
sentences.zh: 定价和计划： 4 / 5

blocks.html_en: Photoroom: Interface

sentences.en: Photoroom: Interface
sentences.zh: 摄影室：界面

sentences.en: (Image credit: Future)
sentences.zh: （图片来源：未来）

blocks.html_en: • Simple, well designed, and clear interface

sentences.en: Simple, well designed, and clear interface
sentences.zh: 简单、设计精良、界面清晰

blocks.html_en: • Easy ways to import images and work on them

sentences.en: Easy ways to import images and work on them
sentences.zh: 导入图像并对其进行处理的简单方法

blocks.html_en: • For an online service, I was impressed

sentences.en: For an online service, I was impressed
sentences.zh: 对于在线服务，我印象深刻

blocks.html_en: The interface is simple and well organised. Once you’ve logged in to your account, you’ll find a sidebar to the left which contains various tools you need.

sentences.en: The interface is simple and well organised.
sentences.zh: 界面简单且组织良好。

sentences.en: Once you’ve logged in to your account, you’ll find a sidebar to the left which contains various tools you need.
sentences.zh: 登录帐户后，您会在左侧找到一个侧边栏，其中包含您需要的各种工具。

blocks.html_en: Thiss includes all the AI tools in your arsenal, templates, a direct link to your Shopify account if you have one, a batch tool so you can work on up to 250 images at once, a Brand Kit where you keep all your assets, and a Design section where your products’ photos are stored.

sentences.en: Thiss includes all the AI tools in your arsenal, templates, a direct link to your Shopify account if you have one, a batch tool so you can work on up to 250 images at once, a Brand Kit where you keep all your assets, and a Design section where your products’ photos are stored.
sentences.zh: 这包括您的武器库中的所有 AI 工具、模板、直接链接到您的 Shopify 帐户（如果您有）、批处理工具（以便您可以同时处理最多 250 张图像）、品牌套件（用于保存所有资产）以及设计部分（用于存储产品照片）。

blocks.html_en: All the AI tools, which are essentially all your editing tools, are easy to use: you select one, upload a new photo or select one already in your account, apply the effect and you’re done.

sentences.en: All the AI tools, which are essentially all your editing tools, are easy to use: you select one, upload a new photo or select one already in your account, apply the effect and you’re done.
sentences.zh: 所有的人工智能工具，本质上都是你的编辑工具，都很容易使用：你选择一个，上传一张新照片或选择你帐户中已有的一张，应用效果就完成了。

blocks.html_en: There is one thing that I found surprising: Photoroom supports HEIC, the High Efficiency Image Container. It’s a highly compressed image format that’s been around since 2015 and has been increasingly prevalent since Apple made it the default image format for their iPhones in 2017.

sentences.en: There is one thing that I found surprising: Photoroom supports HEIC, the High Efficiency Image Container.
sentences.zh: 有一件事情让我感到惊讶：Photoroom 支持 HEIC（高效图像容器）。

sentences.en: It’s a highly compressed image format that’s been around since 2015 and has been increasingly prevalent since Apple made it the default image format for their iPhones in 2017.
sentences.zh: 它是一种高度压缩的图像格式，自 2015 年以来一直存在，自从 Apple 在 2017 年将其设为 iPhone 的默认图像格式以来，它变得越来越流行。

blocks.html_en: The reason I make a point of mentioning this is because far too many services still do not support it, forcing any image or photo saved as an HEIC to be converted into either a JPEG or PNG prior to import. There is no such issue here, saving you time and frustration.

sentences.en: The reason I make a point of mentioning this is because far too many services still do not support it, forcing any image or photo saved as an HEIC to be converted into either a JPEG or PNG prior to import.
sentences.zh: 我之所以特别提到这一点，是因为太多的服务仍然不支持它，迫使任何保存为 HEIC 的图像或照片在导入之前转换为 JPEG 或 PNG。

sentences.en: There is no such issue here, saving you time and frustration.
sentences.zh: 这里不存在这样的问题，节省了您的时间和挫败感。

blocks.html_en: • Interface: 4.5 / 5

sentences.en: Interface: 4.5 / 5

blocks.html_en: Photoroom: Tools

sentences.en: Photoroom: Tools
sentences.zh: 摄影室：工具

sentences.en: (Image credit: Future)
sentences.zh: （图片来源：未来）

blocks.html_en: • On the whole, the AI tools do an absolutely excellent job

sentences.en: On the whole, the AI tools do an absolutely excellent job
sentences.zh: 总的来说，人工智能工具做得非常出色

blocks.html_en: • Impressive ways to transform passable shots into something potential customers will love

sentences.en: Impressive ways to transform passable shots into something potential customers will love
sentences.zh: 将过得去的照片转变成潜在客户喜欢的东西的令人印象深刻的方法

blocks.html_en: • But... not all tools are created equal

sentences.en: But...
not all tools are created equal
sentences.zh: 并非所有工具都是一样的

blocks.html_en: Such a service succeeds on the strength of its tools, and Photoroom iss betting the farm on AI for this. But AI is a very generic term these days. Is it really artificial intelligence to remove an image’s background?

sentences.en: Such a service succeeds on the strength of its tools, and Photoroom iss betting the farm on AI for this.
sentences.zh: 这样的服务凭借其工具的优势而取得了成功，Photoroom 为此将赌注押在了人工智能上。

sentences.en: But AI is a very generic term these days.
sentences.zh: 但如今人工智能是一个非常通用的术语。

sentences.en: Is it really artificial intelligence to remove an image’s background?
sentences.zh: 去除图像背景真的是人工智能吗？

blocks.html_en: I’d put it more in the “complex algorithm does a very good job with what it’s given” category. Same with removing objects or people from a photograph and replacing it with an artificially generated background that blends with the existing one.

sentences.en: I’d put it more in the “complex algorithm does a very good job with what it’s given” category.
sentences.zh: 我更倾向于将其归入“复杂算法在给定的情况下做得非常好”类别。

sentences.en: Same with removing objects or people from a photograph and replacing it with an artificially generated background that blends with the existing one.
sentences.zh: 与从照片中删除物体或人物并将其替换为与现有背景混合的人工生成的背景相同。

blocks.html_en: Such tools already existed before “AI” became an all-encompassing marketing brand. Or, taking inspiration from Monty Python's The Life of Brian, “it’s not AI, it’s a very clever tool”.

sentences.en: Such tools already existed before “AI” became an all-encompassing marketing brand.
sentences.zh: 在“人工智能”成为包罗万象的营销品牌之前，此类工具就已经存在。

sentences.en: Or, taking inspiration from Monty Python's The Life of Brian, “it’s not AI, it’s a very clever tool”.
sentences.zh: 或者，从 Monty Python 的《布莱恩的一生》中汲取灵感，“这不是人工智能，而是一个非常聪明的工具”。

blocks.html_en: But whether it’s AI or not is less important than how these tools fare: I found the achieved results to be excellent. More often than not in apps like Photoshop or Pixelmator Pro, I end up having to touch up the output of similar tools, but here, it was essentially a one-click wonder.

sentences.en: But whether it’s AI or not is less important than how these tools fare: I found the achieved results to be excellent.
sentences.zh: 但是否是人工智能并不重要，重要的是这些工具的表现如何：我发现所取得的结果非常出色。

sentences.en: More often than not in apps like Photoshop or Pixelmator Pro, I end up having to touch up the output of similar tools, but here, it was essentially a one-click wonder.
sentences.zh: 在 Photoshop 或 Pixelmator Pro 等应用程序中，我常常不得不修改类似工具的输出，但在这里，这本质上是一键式的奇迹。

blocks.html_en: Tools that really impressed me were definitely more AI based. Say you want to sell a shirt, which you’ve photographed on a surface, with as few wrinkles as you can manage… except you know how it is: such layouts are never really good enough.

sentences.en: Tools that really impressed me were definitely more AI based.
sentences.zh: 真正给我留下深刻印象的工具肯定更多是基于人工智能的。

sentences.en: Say you want to sell a shirt, which you’ve photographed on a surface, with as few wrinkles as you can manage…
sentences.zh: 假设您想出售一件衬衫，您在表面上拍摄了这件衬衫，并且褶皱尽可能少......

sentences.en: except you know how it is: such layouts are never really good enough.
sentences.zh: 除非你知道它是怎么回事：这样的布局永远都不够好。

sentences.en: (Image credit: Future)
sentences.zh: （图片来源：未来）

blocks.html_en: Well fret no more: Photoroom has a tool that digitally irons your shirt for you, transforming your amateurish-looking photo into a meticulously smooth out product. Couple that with the background remover tool, and you’re well on your way to have a professional looking photograph.

sentences.en: Well fret no more: Photoroom has a tool that digitally irons your shirt for you, transforming your amateurish-looking photo into a meticulously smooth out product.
sentences.zh: 不用再担心了：Photoroom 有一个工具可以为您以数字方式熨烫您的衬衫，将您看似业余的照片转变成精心平滑的产品。

sentences.en: Couple that with the background remover tool, and you’re well on your way to have a professional looking photograph.
sentences.zh: 将其与背景去除工具结合起来，您就可以轻松获得专业的照片了。

blocks.html_en: But why stop there? Photoroom has a bunch of AI-generated models who can wear your outfit for you. There’s even what they call a ‘ghost mannequin’ to puff up your shirt so customers can see what it would look like on someone, without being distracted by an actual (or virtual) person wearing it.

sentences.en: But why stop there?
sentences.zh: 但为什么要停在那里呢？

sentences.en: Photoroom has a bunch of AI-generated models who can wear your outfit for you.
sentences.zh: Photoroom 有一堆人工智能生成的模特，可以为你穿上你的衣服。

sentences.en: There’s even what they call a ‘ghost mannequin’ to puff up your shirt so customers can see what it would look like on someone, without being distracted by an actual (or virtual) person wearing it.
sentences.zh: 甚至还有一种被他们称为“幽灵人体模型”的东西，可以让你的衬衫膨胀起来，这样顾客就可以看到它穿在某人身上的样子，而不会被穿着它的真实（或虚拟）人分散注意力。

blocks.html_en: I found all this pretty incredible, and that’s just scratching the surface. It’s not all sunshine and rainbows though: for instance, Photoroom has a Video Generator.

sentences.en: I found all this pretty incredible, and that’s just scratching the surface.
sentences.zh: 我发现这一切都非常令人难以置信，而这只是冰山一角。

sentences.en: It’s not all sunshine and rainbows though: for instance, Photoroom has a Video Generator.
sentences.zh: 但这并不全是阳光和彩虹：例如，Photoroom 有一个视频生成器。

blocks.html_en: Select a photo, browse through all available templates, maybe even type in a prompt if you need, and the AI will get to work… this is where I encountered the familiar “AI tries way too hard yet fails miserably” syndrome.

sentences.en: Select a photo, browse through all available templates, maybe even type in a prompt if you need, and the AI will get to work…
sentences.zh: 选择一张照片，浏览所有可用的模板，如果需要，甚至可以输入提示，人工智能就会开始工作……

sentences.en: this is where I encountered the familiar “AI tries way too hard yet fails miserably” syndrome.
sentences.zh: 这就是我遇到熟悉的“人工智能尝试太多但惨败”综合症的地方。

blocks.html_en: Some templates removed my test products from the usual confines of physical reality, sometimes in a most disturbing way. Or they just didn’t work at all as expected. I trust the team working hard on this aspect of the service (what I was able to use bore no relation to their intro video about it, so things are moving fast in this arena), but for now, maybe stick with still images, where the results are truly impressive.

sentences.en: Some templates removed my test products from the usual confines of physical reality, sometimes in a most disturbing way.
sentences.zh: 一些模板将我的测试产品从物理现实的通常限制中移除，有时以一种最令人不安的方式。

sentences.en: Or they just didn’t work at all as expected.
sentences.zh: 或者它们根本没有按预期工作。

sentences.en: I trust the team working hard on this aspect of the service (what I was able to use bore no relation to their intro video about it, so things are moving fast in this arena), but for now, maybe stick with still images, where the results are truly impressive.
sentences.zh: 我相信团队在服务的这方面努力工作（我能够使用的内容与他们的介绍视频无关，因此这个领域的事情进展很快），但现在，也许坚持使用静态图像，其结果确实令人印象深刻。

blocks.html_en: Photoroom: AI credits

sentences.en: Photoroom: AI credits
sentences.zh: 摄影室：AI 积分

sentences.en: (Image credit: Future)
sentences.zh: （图片来源：未来）

blocks.html_en: • Set number of monthly credits, so use them wisely

sentences.en: Set number of monthly credits, so use them wisely
sentences.zh: 设置每月积分数量，明智地使用它们

blocks.html_en: • Many common AI tools don't cost any credits at all

sentences.en: Many common AI tools don't cost any credits at all
sentences.zh: 许多常见的人工智能工具根本不需要任何学分

blocks.html_en: • However, sometimes, the requested action won’t work, so try, try again

sentences.en: However, sometimes, the requested action won’t work, so try, try again
sentences.zh: 然而，有时，所请求的操作不起作用，所以请尝试，再试一次

blocks.html_en: As you’d expect, most AI tools will cost you credits. A video generation goes for 500 (money not well spent for now), Exporting an image at 2K or 4K will cost you 135 and 240 credits respectively, adding an AI background to an image is worth 5 credits, and so forth.

sentences.en: As you’d expect, most AI tools will cost you credits.
sentences.zh: 正如您所料，大多数人工智能工具都会花费您学分。

sentences.en: A video generation goes for 500 (money not well spent for now), Exporting an image at 2K or 4K will cost you 135 and 240 credits respectively, adding an AI background to an image is worth 5 credits, and so forth.
sentences.zh: 生成一个视频需要 500 个积分（目前来说钱花得不值），导出 2K 或 4K 图像将分别花费 135 和 240 个积分，为图像添加 AI 背景值 5 个积分，依此类推。

blocks.html_en: Thankfully though, some tools you’ll use most often, like removing the background of a shot, retouching a photo or performing some image enhancements won’t cost you a thing (beyond your subscription).

sentences.en: Thankfully though, some tools you’ll use most often, like removing the background of a shot, retouching a photo or performing some image enhancements won’t cost you a thing (beyond your subscription).
sentences.zh: 不过值得庆幸的是，您最常使用的一些工具，例如删除镜头的背景、修饰照片或执行一些图像增强功能，不会花费您任何费用（超出您的订阅费用）。

blocks.html_en: You’ll just have to balance what you are given each month with what you hope to achieve in that time period, with the relief that when an action doesn’t work, you won’t have lost any credits - yes, sometimes an error occurs.

sentences.en: You’ll just have to balance what you are given each month with what you hope to achieve in that time period, with the relief that when an action doesn’t work, you won’t have lost any credits - yes, sometimes an error occurs.
sentences.zh: 你只需要平衡你每月获得的奖励和你希望在该时间段内实现的目标，并放心，当某个行动不起作用时，你不会失去任何积分 - 是的，有时会发生错误。

blocks.html_en: However, I found that if I request the same action again - and again - it finally does what I asked it to. Teething problems, I’m sure, and at least it does work impressively well eventually.

sentences.en: However, I found that if I request the same action again - and again - it finally does what I asked it to.
sentences.zh: 然而，我发现，如果我一次又一次请求相同的操作，它最终会按照我的要求执行。

sentences.en: Teething problems, I’m sure, and at least it does work impressively well eventually.
sentences.zh: 出牙问题，我确信，至少它最终确实效果令人印象深刻。

blocks.html_en: Should I buy Photoroom?

sentences.en: Should I buy Photoroom?
sentences.zh: 我应该买Photoroom吗？

blocks.html_en: Image 1 of 3

sentences.en: Image 1 of 3
sentences.zh: 第 1 张图片（共 3 张）

sentences.en: (Image credit: Future)
sentences.zh: （图片来源：未来）

blocks.html_en: Buy it if...

sentences.en: Buy it if...
sentences.zh: 买它，如果...

blocks.html_en: You’re looking to sell a ton of product and want the images advertising your wares to look their best, using a service that is well designed, and is easy to use (when it works)

sentences.en: You’re looking to sell a ton of product and want the images advertising your wares to look their best, using a service that is well designed, and is easy to use (when it works)
sentences.zh: 您希望销售大量产品，并希望使用设计精良且易于使用（有效时）的服务，使您的商品广告图像看起来最好

blocks.html_en: Don't buy it if...

sentences.en: Don't buy it if...
sentences.zh: 不要购买它，如果...

blocks.html_en: You don’t want to encourage the proliferation of AI, know your way around Photoshop anyway, and can’t justify yet another subscription, no matter how great some effects are.

sentences.en: You don’t want to encourage the proliferation of AI, know your way around Photoshop anyway, and can’t justify yet another subscription, no matter how great some effects are.
sentences.zh: 你不想鼓励人工智能的扩散，无论如何都了解 Photoshop，并且无论某些效果有多么出色，都无法证明再次订阅是合理的。

blocks.html_en: How I tested Photoroom

sentences.en: How I tested Photoroom
sentences.zh: 我如何测试 Photoroom

blocks.html_en: I tested this service on my trusty Apple MacBook Pro. Generally I do my best to check how software works on a variety of devices, both Macs and PCs and portable devices, when needed.

sentences.en: I tested this service on my trusty Apple MacBook Pro.
sentences.zh: 我在我值得信赖的 Apple MacBook Pro 上测试了这项服务。

sentences.en: Generally I do my best to check how software works on a variety of devices, both Macs and PCs and portable devices, when needed.
sentences.zh: 一般来说，当需要时，我会尽力检查软件在各种设备（Mac、PC 和便携式设备）上的运行情况。

blocks.html_en: But as this was an online service, whose tools are dependent on servers the main bottleneck would be my fibre connection. I experienced no issues on that score.

sentences.en: But as this was an online service, whose tools are dependent on servers the main bottleneck would be my fibre connection.
sentences.zh: 但由于这是一项在线服务，其工具依赖于服务器，因此主要瓶颈将是我的光纤连接。

sentences.en: I experienced no issues on that score.
sentences.zh: 我在这方面没有遇到任何问题。

blocks.html_en: Everything was extremely responsive. The free tools were nearly instantaneous, and depending on the complexity of what I was asking the AI to do, it took gradually longer.

sentences.en: Everything was extremely responsive.

content_html_zh:
Photoroom 基本上做到了它所说的：将产品照片转换成看起来专业且有吸引力的东西。 这些工具很容易使用，而且总体来说它们工作得很好。 如果您拥有在线零售业务，该平台可为您的产品提供您所追求的专业外观。

Pros

  • +大多数人工智能工具都运行得非常好
  • +易于使用
  • +适用于多种浏览器
  • +支持HEIC图像格式

Cons

  • -AI积分可能很快就会耗尽
  • - 有时需要重复您的请求才能正常工作
  • -视频生成器需要一些工作

为什么您可以信任 TechRadar 我们花费数小时测试我们审查的每项产品或服务，因此您可以确保您购买的是最好的。 详细了解我们如何进行测试。

我对人工智能照片编辑器很感兴趣已经有一段时间了。 有些工作得很好，有些则不太好。 Photoroom属于前者阵营。 总的来说，我发现人工智能工具非常令人印象深刻且使用直观。 我将对此提出一些警告，但总的来说，Photoroom 兑现了它的承诺。

但它到底承诺了什么？ 现在，与许多人工智能照片编辑器相比，这里的事情有点不同。 这不是一个用于修饰您的假期快照或点亮社交媒体帖子的平台。

这里的重点是商业用途。 实际上，如果您经营一家在线商店或类似商店，那么您可以使用 Photoroom 将古板、沉闷的产品照片转变为从页面上弹出的更具吸引力和吸引力的图像。

来自TechRadar 的最新视频

自从三年前我们上次审查它以来，我很想知道它是如何发展的——从那时起人工智能已经取得了长足的进步——我尝试了这个平台，看看我能创造什么。

摄影室：定价和计划

  • 通过浏览器、iOS 和 Android 应用程序在线服务
  • 针对大大小小的企业
  • 价格合理的订阅和免费试用

您可以点击此处查看 Photoroom。

该平台可通过适用于您的 iPhone 或 Android 手机的专用应用程序在线使用，或者如果您在计算机上工作，则可通过您最喜欢的网络浏览器在线使用。 与我测试过的许多产品不同，您在这里不仅限于 Chrome 或 Edge。

与任何在线服务一样，您需要订阅才能使用它，并按年计费。 摄影室分为三层。

你是专业人士吗？ 订阅我们的时事通讯

订阅 TechRadar Pro 时事通讯，获取您的企业成功所需的所有热门新闻、观点、功能和指导！

推荐给“个体创业者”的“Pro”，每月费用为 13 美元，按年计费。 此级别每月为您授予 4,250 个 AI 积分，允许您执行 1,000 次导出，并附带 Photoroom 的标准工具集。

中间层是“Max”，专为小型企业设计。 每月只需​​ 35 美元（同样，按年计费 - 所有级别均如此），您的积分将高达 12,000，您的导出量将高达 3,000，并且现在可以使用先进的“视频生成器”工具。

最后，还有“Ultra”，代表“成长中的品牌”。 您将获得 20,000 个 AI 积分、10,000 个导出，并且可以创建 4K 视频和图像，每月只需 100 美元。

如果您正在寻找更加定制的选项，可以选择定制的企业级，并提供与之相匹配的定制成本。

我建议您检查价格，因为 Photoroom 经常在这些标准价格的基础上提供折扣。 另外，您可以免费试用这些级别中的任何一个 7 天，不过，如果您决定不继续使用该服务，请不要忘记在此之前取消试用，并且您会因忘记而不必要地支付巨额费用。

Photoroom 足够慷慨，允许我​​访问他们的 Ultra 级别，所以让我们看看它的能力，以及你可以用所有这些 AI 积分做什么。

  • 定价和计划： 4 / 5

摄影室：界面

  • 简单、设计精良、界面清晰
  • 导入图像并对其进行处理的简单方法
  • 对于在线服务，我印象深刻

界面简单且组织良好。 登录帐户后，您会在左侧找到一个侧边栏，其中包含您需要的各种工具。

这包括您的武器库中的所有 AI 工具、模板、直接链接到您的 Shopify 帐户（如果您有）、批处理工具（以便您可以同时处理最多 250 张图像）、品牌套件（用于保存所有资产）以及设计部分（用于存储产品照片）。

所有的人工智能工具，本质上都是你的编辑工具，都很容易使用：你选择一个，上传一张新照片或选择你帐户中已有的一张，应用效果就完成了。

有一件事情让我感到惊讶：Photoroom 支持 HEIC（高效图像容器）。 它是一种高度压缩的图像格式，自 2015 年以来一直存在，自从 Apple 在 2017 年将其设为 iPhone 的默认图像格式以来，它变得越来越流行。

我之所以特别提到这一点，是因为太多的服务仍然不支持它，迫使任何保存为 HEIC 的图像或照片在导入之前转换为 JPEG 或 PNG。 这里不存在这样的问题，节省了您的时间和挫败感。

  • 接口：4.5/5

摄影室：工具

  • 总的来说，人工智能工具做得非常出色
  • 将过得去的照片转变成潜在客户喜欢的东西的令人印象深刻的方法
  • 但... 并非所有工具都是一样的

这样的服务凭借其工具的优势而取得了成功，Photoroom 为此将赌注押在了人工智能上。 但如今人工智能是一个非常通用的术语。 去除图像背景真的是人工智能吗？

我更倾向于将其归入“复杂算法在给定的情况下做得非常好”类别。 与从照片中删除物体或人物并将其替换为与现有背景混合的人工生成的背景相同。

在“人工智能”成为包罗万象的营销品牌之前，此类工具就已经存在。 或者，从 Monty Python 的《布莱恩的一生》中汲取灵感，“这不是人工智能，而是一个非常聪明的工具”。

但是否是人工智能并不重要，重要的是这些工具的表现如何：我发现所取得的结果非常出色。 在 Photoshop 或 Pixelmator Pro 等应用程序中，我常常不得不修改类似工具的输出，但在这里，这本质上是一键式的奇迹。

真正给我留下深刻印象的工具肯定更多是基于人工智能的。 假设您想出售一件衬衫，您在表面上拍摄了这件衬衫，并且褶皱尽可能少...... 除非你知道它是怎么回事：这样的布局永远都不够好。

不用再担心了：Photoroom 有一个工具可以为您以数字方式熨烫您的衬衫，将您看似业余的照片转变成精心平滑的产品。 将其与背景去除工具结合起来，您就可以轻松获得专业的照片了。

但为什么要停在那里呢？ Photoroom 有一堆人工智能生成的模特，可以为你穿上你的衣服。 甚至还有一种被他们称为“幽灵人体模型”的东西，可以让你的衬衫膨胀起来，这样顾客就可以看到它穿在某人身上的样子，而不会被穿着它的真实（或虚拟）人分散注意力。

我发现这一切都非常令人难以置信，而这只是冰山一角。 但这并不全是阳光和彩虹：例如，Photoroom 有一个视频生成器。

选择一张照片，浏览所有可用的模板，如果需要，甚至可以输入提示，人工智能就会开始工作…… 这就是我遇到熟悉的“人工智能尝试太多但惨败”综合症的地方。

一些模板将我的测试产品从物理现实的通常限制中移除，有时以一种最令人不安的方式。 或者它们根本没有按预期工作。 我相信团队在服务的这方面努力工作（我能够使用的内容与他们的介绍视频无关，因此这个领域的事情进展很快），但现在，也许坚持使用静态图像，其结果确实令人印象深刻。

摄影室：AI 积分

  • 设置每月积分数量，明智地使用它们
  • 许多常见的人工智能工具根本不需要任何学分
  • 然而，有时，所请求的操作不起作用，所以请尝试，再试一次

正如您所料，大多数人工智能工具都会花费您学分。 生成一个视频需要 500 个积分（目前来说钱花得不值），导出 2K 或 4K 图像将分别花费 135 和 240 个积分，为图像添加 AI 背景值 5 个积分，依此类推。

不过值得庆幸的是，您最常使用的一些工具，例如删除镜头的背景、修饰照片或执行一些图像增强功能，不会花费您任何费用（超出您的订阅费用）。

你只需要平衡你每月获得的奖励和你希望在该时间段内实现的目标，并放心，当某个行动不起作用时，你不会失去任何积分 - 是的，有时会发生错误。

然而，我发现，如果我一次又一次请求相同的操作，它最终会按照我的要求执行。 出牙问题，我确信，至少它最终确实效果令人印象深刻。

我应该买Photoroom吗？

第 1 张图片（共 3 张）

买它，如果...

您希望销售大量产品，并希望使用设计精良且易于使用（有效时）的服务，使您的商品广告图像看起来最好

不要购买它，如果...

你不想鼓励人工智能的扩散，无论如何都了解 Photoshop，并且无论某些效果有多么出色，都无法证明再次订阅是合理的。

我如何测试 Photoroom

我在我值得信赖的 Apple MacBook Pro 上测试了这项服务。 一般来说，当需要时，我会尽力检查软件在各种设备（Mac、PC 和便携式设备）上的运行情况。

但由于这是一项在线服务，其工具依赖于服务器，因此主要瓶颈将是我的光纤连接。 我在这方面没有遇到任何问题。

一切都反应非常灵敏。 免费工具几乎是即时的，并且根据我要求人工智能做的事情的复杂性，它花费的时间逐渐更长。

视频创作花费的时间最长，对我来说大约需要 4 分钟。 不过，当我开始工作时，感觉时间并不长。

对于更多创意工具，我们测试了最好的照片编辑器。

Steve 自 2003 年以来一直在撰写有关技术的文章。 从数字创意艺术开始，他在 iCreate、MacFormat、MacWorld、MacLife 和 TechRadar 等领域积累了自己的技术专业知识。 他的重点是创意艺术，例如网站构建器、图像处理和电影制作软件，但他也没有回避更多面向商业的软件。 他在个人和职业生活中使用了他所写的许多应用程序。 史蒂夫喜欢计算机如何帮助每个人探索创造性的可能性，并且总是很高兴与读者分享他的知识、专业知识和经验。
